items.title: Walmart, Target, and Nvidia Headline a Pivotal Week for Q3 Earnings
items.summary: Nvidia, Target, and Walmart reflect three notable upcoming releases in the Q3 earnings season, with Nvidia's release wrapping up the reporting cycle for the Magnificent 7 group. Total Q3 earnings for the S&P 500 members that have reported are up +24.9% year-over-year on +13.7% higher revenues.
